{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep the row with the highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Filter for treatment arm
treatment_only = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Compute number of patients in treatment arm
n_treatment = len(treatment_only)

# Compute number of responders in treatment arm
n_responded = treatment_only['responded'].sum()

# Compute fraction
fraction_responded = n_responded / n_treatment

# Print only the numbers that will appear in evidence, in the exact order
print(n_treatment)
print(n_responded)
print(fraction_responded)"}
